_comment: OPTIONAL ADVANCED EXAMPLE — not the plugin v1 default. Prefer stdio (${CPC_ROOT}/servers/*.exe) from mcp.json / mcp.optionals.example.json. Use shared-host HTTP only on machines that already run the cpc shared-mcp daemon. Do NOT invent an HTTP path (/sse or otherwise): set each url to match the shared-host MCP endpoint from that machine's Cursor mcp.json. Autonomous port 7771 is a paid wedge and MUST NOT appear in free Toolbelt wire examples.

_port_map_owner_verified_BEE.autonomous: 7771 — PAID WEDGE ONLY; do not wire in free Toolbelt examples
_port_map_owner_verified_BEE.voice: 7776 — may be cold / not always running

cpc-hands._comment: EXAMPLE SHAPE ONLY — replace url with the real shared-host endpoint from local Cursor mcp.json on a daemon host. Port 7772 = hands.

cpc-manager._comment: Optional. Port 7774 = manager. Merge only if opted in.

cpc-voice._comment: Optional. Port 7776 = voice. Voice may be cold on the reference host.

cpc-programmer._comment: Directed only (never default on Cursor). Port 7777 = programmer.
